brief: The canvas reveals a massive, open-world cityscape, displaying towering buildings and expansive ground surfaces. Time is a visible element, as the buildings cast dynamic shadows that sweep across the pavement. The ground surface itself is highly textured, showing differential weathering and accumulated grime that visibly settles and darkens in the crevices and areas untouched by the current shadows, creating a sense of deep, simulated reality. The environment is constantly changing as the simulated time of day passes, revealing the minute details of the aged urban terrain without requiring any direct interaction from the viewer.
